queries.query: "large language model" OR LLM OR "generative AI" AND ("network configuration" OR NetOps OR "network operations" OR "configuration generation" OR "intent-to-configuration")
queries.rationale: Locate direct prior work applying LLMs / generative models to NetOps tasks (intent->config, config synthesis, automated NetOps pipelines).

queries.query: ("configuration repair" OR "config repair" OR "configuration debugging" OR "configuration synthesis") AND (LLM OR "large language model" OR GPT OR "generative model")
queries.rationale: Find literature on automated repair/patching of network configs using LLMs or program-synthesis techniques to understand common failure/repair modes.

queries.query: ("generate-validate-repair" OR "generate validate repair" OR "verify and repair" OR "verify-and-repair") AND (LLM OR "language model" OR "tool-assisted" OR "verifier") AND (network OR NetOps OR "network configuration")
queries.rationale: Survey architectural patterns that pair generation with formal or heuristic validation and iterative repair, crucial for safe NetOps automation.

queries.query: ("network verification" OR "formal verification" OR "header space analysis" OR NetKAT OR Batfish OR "model checking") AND ("configuration" OR "policy" OR "reachability" OR "firewall")
queries.rationale: Collect classical and modern validators/verifiers used to assess correctness of network configs (foundations for any LLM-based verifier integration).

queries.query: (LLM OR "large language model" OR "autonomous agent" OR agentic) AND (safety OR reliability OR "failure mode" OR robustness OR "trustworthiness") AND (operations OR NetOps OR "system administration")
queries.rationale: Identify studies on safety, reliability, and failure modes of agentic LLMs in operational contexts to inform threat modelling and mitigation design.

queries.query: ("constrained generation" OR "constrained decoding" OR "safe decoding" OR "policy-guided generation" OR "output constraints") AND (LLM OR "language model") AND (network OR configuration OR NetOps)
queries.rationale: Find methods to restrict or steer LLM outputs (schema/grammar constraints, DSL generation) applicable to preventing unsafe network changes.

queries.query: (benchmark OR evaluation OR dataset OR "AIOps" OR "NetOps benchmark" OR "6G-Bench" OR "TSNBench" OR OpsEval OR OWL) AND (LLM OR "language model" OR "generative AI") AND (network OR NetOps OR "network configuration")
queries.rationale: Locate existing benchmarks and datasets assessing LLMs/AIOps systems for NetOps-related tasks and critique their construct/external validity.

queries.query: ("network simulator" OR emulator OR Mininet OR ns-3 OR "testbed" OR "production trace") AND ("configuration execution" OR validation OR evaluation OR "fault injection")
queries.rationale: Identify experimental platforms and datasets for executing or emulating network configurations and for realistic evaluation of generated configs.
source_preferences: tool repositories (Mininet, ns-3, public testbeds like Emulab)

queries.query: ("tool use" OR "tool-augmented" OR "tool-using" OR "LLM tools" OR "agent framework" OR "orchestration") AND (AIOps OR NetOps OR automation)
queries.rationale: Find frameworks and orchestration patterns where LLMs are composed with external tools (verifiers, CLI runners, parsers) relevant to operational pipelines.

queries.query: (metric OR "evaluation metric" OR "operational correctness" OR "policy compliance" OR reachability OR connectivity OR "semantic correctness") AND ("network configuration" OR NetOps OR firewall OR routing)
queries.rationale: Assemble candidate quantitative and qualitative metrics that map to operational correctness, safety, and trust for generated NetOps artifacts.

queries.query: ("human-in-the-loop" OR "human oversight" OR "operator trust" OR "human-AI interaction") AND (LLM OR "AI assistant") AND ("network operations" OR NetOps OR "system administration")
queries.rationale: Survey human factors work on how operators interact with AI assistants in Ops and how trust/oversight affect deployment choices and evaluation.

queries.query: (adversarial OR robustness OR perturbation OR "stress test" OR "fault injection") AND (LLM OR "language model") AND ("network configuration" OR NetOps OR "automation")
queries.rationale: Search for methodologies that evaluate LLM robustness under adversarial or perturbed inputs and how such tests map to NetOps threat models.

queries.query: ("LLM for DevOps" OR "LLM for sysadmin" OR "AIOps" OR "LLM for cloud operations" OR "IT automation")
queries.rationale: Gather neighboring-domain work (DevOps, cloud ops, DBAs) where LLMs automate configuration/operational tasks to transfer methods and lessons to NetOps.

inclusion_criteria: Peer-reviewed conference or journal papers, or arXiv preprints with traceable authors/affiliations.
Publicly accessible tool, dataset, or benchmark repositories with versioned artifacts (GitHub, Zenodo, institutional pages).
Standards documents and RFCs relevant to network semantics and protocols.
Public technical reports, whitepapers, or reproducible case studies from vendors only if primary claims are verifiable (e.g., accompanying artifacts or citations).
Works dated primarily from 2010–2026, with prioritization for 2018–2026 for LLM-era relevance.
exclusion_criteria: Unverifiable blog posts, press releases, marketing materials, or social-media threads without supporting artifacts.
Proprietary internal reports or NDA-protected documents inaccessible to reviewers.
Content lacking author/venue metadata or stable identifiers (no DOI/arXiv/URL).
Purely conceptual opinion pieces without empirical, theoretical, or reproducible artifacts relevant to NetOps.
date_rationale: Include foundational network-verification and NetOps works from ~2010 onward (e.g., header-space, NetKAT era) while prioritizing 2018–2026 literature for LLM and agentic-AI developments. This range captures classical validators, the rise of programmatic synthesis, and the recent surge in LLM-based automation and safety research necessary to position a 2026 CNSM study.
